certificate.module_name: Seagate SSG5 TCG Enterprise SSC SED FIPS 140 Module
certificate.caveat: When operated in approved mode. When installed, initialized and configured as specified in Section 11 of the Security Policy. No operator authentication is enforced for executing security services that were unlocked by an authenticated service
certificate.description: The primary function of the Seagate SSG5 TCG Enterprise SSC SED FIPS 140 Module is to provide encryption, access control, and cryptographic erase of the User Data stored on the module.
